title: Shared definitions
description: Definitions shared by the package file schemas.

packageId.description: Package ID: upper-case letters and digits, starting with a letter.

localName.description: Name of a field or foreign key of a table, without namespace.

field.description: A field of a table or an extension.

domain.description: Domain of the field. Use either domain or dataElement.

notNull.description: Whether the field rejects NULL. Primary key fields are always NOT NULL.

default.description: Default value. A missing default, null and "" are three different cases: no default, the explicit default null, and the empty string. Strings for CHAR, STRING, DATE, TIMESTAMP, UUID and DEC; integers for INT4 and INT8; booleans for BOOL.

dataElement.description: Data element of the field; its domain gives the type. Use either domain or dataElement.

foreignKey.description: A foreign key referencing the complete primary key of a target table.

fields.description: Mapping of local fields to key fields of the target table. The tenant field is added automatically.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code in lower case.

operations.description: Operations allowed on the rows of a table in a setting.

settingTable.description: A dependent table of a setting: it references its parent table in the setting through one of its foreign keys.

foreignKey.description: Name of the foreign key of the table to the parent table; extension keys carry their namespace.

objectName.description: Name of an object of a package, starting with the namespace of the package, e.g. /TRFIN/COMPANIES. The kernel checks the namespace when it imports the package.

extensionField.description: A field added by an extension. Its name carries the namespace of the extending package.

domain.description: Domain of the field. Use either domain or dataElement.

notNull.description: Whether the field rejects NULL. Primary key fields are always NOT NULL.

default.description: Default value. A missing default, null and "" are three different cases: no default, the explicit default null, and the empty string. Strings for CHAR, STRING, DATE, TIMESTAMP, UUID and DEC; integers for INT4 and INT8; booleans for BOOL.

dataElement.description: Data element of the field; its domain gives the type. Use either domain or dataElement.

extensionForeignKey.description: A foreign key added by an extension. Its name and its fields carry the namespace of the extending package.

fields.description: Mapping of local fields to key fields of the target table. The tenant field is added automatically.
